name: Base-install-Triton-SageAttention-Manager
description:
A **bare ComfyUI install** with **Triton** and **SageAttention** pre-installed and ComfyUI-Manager for adding nodes afterwards.

- Triton compiles custom GPU kernels for supported nodes/attention implementations
- SageAttention is a drop-in quantized attention kernel that noticeably speeds up sampling on supported cards with minimal quality loss
- No models or workflows are bundled — this is a performance-tuned starting point, not a ready-to-run workload

Use this when you want a ComfyUI base that's already primed for the faster attention backends other workload packs expect.
